plan_mode.full:
# Plan mode

The session is in plan mode. Do not change files or run commands that change anything. Explore with Read, Glob and Grep, write the plan, then call ExitPlanMode with it.
plan_mode.min:
# Plan mode

Plan mode. No file changes, no state-changing commands. Explore with Read, Glob, Grep, write plan, call ExitPlanMode with it.

declined.full: The user declined this tool call, so it did not run. Do not retry it or work around it; ask what they would like instead.
declined.min: User declined this tool call; not run. Don't retry or work around; ask what they want.

cancelled_before_run.full: The tool call was cancelled before it ran.

cut_off_call.full: Your reply reached the output token limit while you were still writing this {name} call, so its arguments were cut off and it did not run. Make the call again with less output at once: for a large file, Write a short first part, then add the rest with Edit calls.
cut_off_call.min: Reply hit output token limit mid-{name} call; arguments cut off, not run. Retry with less output per call: large file = short Write first, then Edit calls for rest.

cut_off_reply.full: Your last reply reached the output token limit and was cut off. Carry on from where it stopped. Keep each reply shorter, thinking included: do not draft whole files in your thinking, and write large files in parts.
cut_off_reply.min: Last reply hit output token limit, cut off. Continue where stopped. Keep replies shorter, thinking included: no drafting whole files in thinking; write large files in parts.

not_in_plan_mode.full: {name} is not available in plan mode. Explore with Read, Glob and Grep, then call ExitPlanMode with your plan.
not_in_plan_mode.min: {name} unavailable in plan mode. Explore with Read, Glob, Grep, then call ExitPlanMode with plan.

call_stopped.full: The user stopped this tool call before it finished, so it has no complete result. Carry on without it, or ask what they would like instead. Do not retry it unless asked.
call_stopped.min: User stopped this tool call before finish; no complete result. Carry on without it, or ask what they want. Don't retry unless asked.

notes_intro.full:
Background subagents have finished. Their results are below; read them and carry on. Do not repeat them verbatim to the user unless asked.

{body}
notes_intro.min:
Background subagents finished. Results below; read, carry on. Don't repeat verbatim to user unless asked.

{body}

stalled_agents.full:
Background subagents have gone quiet. Their state is below. One that is waiting for the user is held up by a permission prompt the user has not answered: tell the user. For one that is stuck, look again with TaskStatus; if it has not moved, stop it with TaskStop and start it again if its work is still needed.

{body}
stalled_agents.min:
Background subagents gone quiet. State below. One waiting for user is held by permission prompt user hasn't answered: tell user. For stuck one, check TaskStatus; if still not moving, TaskStop, restart if work still needed.

{body}

fork_note.full: You are a fork of the main agent: its conversation above is yours to read, but you are a separate run. Do exactly the directive below and then stop. Do not start subagents. Finish with a short report of what you found or did; that report is all the main agent sees.
fork_note.min: You are fork of main agent: conversation above is yours to read, but you are separate run. Do exactly directive below, then stop. No subagents. Finish with short report of what you found/did; report is all main agent sees.

bg_started.full: Subagent {handle} ({kind}) started in the background. Its report arrives as a task notification; carry on, and do not poll. Stop it with TaskStop, or send it a message with SendMessage.
bg_started.min: Subagent {handle} ({kind}) started in background. Report arrives as task notification; carry on, don't poll. Stop with TaskStop, message with SendMessage.

bg_continuing.full: {to} ({kind}) is continuing in the background; its report arrives as a task notification.
bg_continuing.min: {to} ({kind}) continuing in background; report arrives as task notification.

compact_system.full: You summarize conversations between a user and a coding agent, faithfully and in detail.
compact_system.min: Summarize user/coding-agent conversations faithfully, in detail.

compact_continue.full: The session continues from the conversation summarized above. Pick up where it left off. Do not repeat finished work, and do not mention the summary unless asked.
compact_continue.min: Session continues from summary above. Pick up where it left off. No repeating finished work; don't mention summary unless asked.

compact_focus.full: The user asked that the summary pay particular attention to: {focus}

web_answer_system.full: You answer questions about a web page. Use only the page content. Be concise and quote sparingly.
web_answer_system.min: Answer questions about web page. Page content only. Concise, quote sparingly.

search_sources.full: When you use these results, cite the pages as Markdown links in a Sources section at the end of your answer.
search_sources.min: Using these results: cite pages as Markdown links in Sources section at end of answer.
